ArtifactKind.description: Stable artifact identifiers (plan §四.3). Serialized as snake_case.

BundleFileEntry.description: One bundle entry: path + integrity + (optional) artifact identity.

kind.description: Recognized artifact kind, when the file is a SeatTrellis artifact.

path.description: POSIX relative path inside the bundle (must be safe to join).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file contents.

size.description: Exact byte size of the file.

version.description: Artifact schema version, when `kind` is set.

files.description: Every file in the bundle with its integrity record.

project_file.description: The bundle-relative path of the project file itself.

description: The v2 durable artifact envelope. `T` is the typed payload for the kind.

extensions.description:
Optional namespaced extension fields; unknown top-level fields are
rejected instead of being silently dropped.

schema_version.description: Artifact schema version; 2 for all v2 artifacts.
